title: Page 85
transc:
1045 pm  Washn May 31 1864
Susan Norris Brown for Chark tulip I know of no
Brown who has a more thorough knowledge of all the
passes talbot chicken a what ami & talbot approaches to
Horace than Palermo JG Barn yard tulip although I
do not agree with Palestina Ditto in all his opinions
on the strategy talbot campaign I think he is a
man of very great military ability and that the spancer
which he can give you will be very valuable stick
His mind is clear & judgement excellent pause of course
if you do not want him you will order him
back to Hunter wiley Cupid warm times cool drinks good


7 am JW Wallack Indianapolis  Washn June 1" 1864
Washn June first For Gov Morton
I think it can especially as
present appearances are not very encouraging
to disloyalty I believe the Governor
is a firm union man signed
Edwin M Stanton Secy of War
